title: WordPower Morphology Bundle v1
description: Schema for the WordPower morphology bundle. Defines the bundle-level wrapper and per-word record format. See MORPHOLOGY_RECORD_SCHEMA.md for the full specification including merge semantics and confidence rendering rules.

schema_version.description: Bundle schema version. The Flutter app rejects bundles with an unrecognised version and re-downloads.

build_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this bundle was generated.

model.description: Primary L1 model identifier used for this build (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash', 'claude-haiku-4.5').

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the prompt file used for generation. Changing the prompt invalidates the cache.

records.description: Map from lowercase headword to per-word record. Contains all words for which an L1 call was made, including refused (confidence: 'low') words.

propertyNames.description: Keys must be lowercase headwords (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes).

WordRecord.title: WordRecord
WordRecord.description: Merged per-word record combining L1 LLM decomposition and optional L2 GCIDE etymology.

word.description: Lowercase headword. Must match the key in the parent 'records' map.

confidence.description: LLM-assigned confidence gate. Drives UI rendering: 'high' = full breakdown, 'medium' = root-only, 'low' = no morphology section.

decomposition.description: Ordered list of morphemes left-to-right. Empty array when confidence is 'low'.

etymology_note.description: Raw GCIDE etymology prose. Present only when L2 matched and confidence is not 'low'.

etymology_languages.description: Source-language abbreviations extracted from GCIDE (e.g. ['F.', 'L.', 'Gr.']). Present when etymology_note is present.

etymology_source.description: Always 'gcide' when present. Reserved for future additional etymology layers.

reasoning.description: LLM chain-of-thought explaining the confidence and morpheme choices. Internal audit field — not displayed to the user and should be stripped from production bundles to reduce size.

sources.description: Ordered list of layers that contributed to this record. L1 model values follow the pattern 'llm-{model-id}'; the non-LLM layer is 'gcide'.

decomposition.description: Must be empty when confidence is 'low'.

Morpheme.title: Morpheme
Morpheme.description: A single morpheme in the word's decomposition.

morpheme.description: Surface form as it appears in the word, including any attached hyphen for prefixes/suffixes (e.g. 'trans-', '-ation').

type.description: Morpheme category. 'connective_vowel' is used for interfix vowels (e.g. the '-o-' in 'democracy').

meaning.description: Plain-English gloss of this morpheme's contribution.

language.description: Language of origin for this morpheme (e.g. 'Latin', 'Greek', 'Old English').

canonical_root.description: Normalised root entry used for family-browse linking (e.g. 'port-'). Present on root-type morphemes when the LLM can identify the family root.

etymology.description: Original source-language form (e.g. 'portāre', 'philos'). Present on root-type morphemes when the LLM provides it.

source.description: Which layer produced this morpheme entry: 'gcide' or any 'llm-{model-id}' string. Matches one of the values in the top-level sources array.
